messages:
Mira Patel: Quick sync — need final owners and public comms plan for the postmortem. Two asks: status page copy + rule for when to publish an RCA summary.

Sam Ortiz: Owners: TTL guard -> @Nikhil, Autoscale -> infra. I'll add due dates in the tracker after we decide targets.

Nikhil Rao: I can take TTL guard. ETA 5 business days -> target 2026-04-03.

CS Bot: CS requests a short status page blurb within 24h and a redacted RCA link. If customers request more, provide an expanded sanitized RCA after Legal review (NDA if needed).

Mira Patel: Proposed policy: publish a redacted RCA summary on the status page within 48h. Full internal RCA stays internal unless required for compliance/legal. For recurring root causes (same tag >2 times in 6 months) trigger a 30-day recurrence review. Agree?

Sam Ortiz: Agree. Also add a checkpoint on 2026-04-06 to verify the fixes and recurrence dashboard.

ops-bot: Action created: "Publish redacted RCA summary" -> assignee: CS -> due 1992628800.

Mira Patel: Draft status blurb for review: "Resolved — a deploy script reset cache TTLs during a traffic spike, increasing latency for a small percent of requests. We reverted the change and applied a guard. Actions: enforce TTL defaults, update autoscale, add rollout gating. A redacted RCA summary is linked on the status page"

Nikhil Rao: Fine. If metrics confirm, replace "small percent" with the numeric percent.

Mira Patel: OK will finalize once Sam/CS confirm metric. I'll update tracker and schedule the 4/6 checkpoint.

Sam Ortiz: I'll confirm the percent by EOD PST and update tracker.
